title: Method Overloading
description: Create multiple versions of the same method name with different parameter lists.

slides.title: One Name, Many Flavors 🍨
slides.content:
# What is Overloading?

**Method overloading** allows you to define multiple methods with the **same name** but **different parameters** (number, types, or both).

```csharp
void ShowMessage(string msg)
void ShowMessage(string msg, Color color)
void ShowMessage(int code)
```

The compiler figures out which one to call based on the arguments you provide.

quizData.question: What makes overloaded methods different from each other?
quizData.explanation: Overloading is based on parameter signature, not return type.

slides.title: Why Overload? 🤔

quizData.question: Can you overload a method by changing only the return type?

options.text: No, the parameter list must differ

quizData.explanation: Return type alone does not distinguish overloads; parameters must differ.

slides.title: Unity Uses Overloading Everywhere
Overloading with Defaults vs Optional Parameters
slides.content:
# Choose Wisely

- **Optional parameters** keep a single method signature clean but can become unwieldy.
- **Overloads** are explicit and allow different implementations per combination.
- Often overloads are implemented by calling a master method with defaults, combining both approaches.
